intro: BLEACH Festival launches this Thursday across the Gold Coast — eleven days of live music, art and theatre at HOTA and Kurrawa Park, opening with a free Lady Blackbird concert Friday night and Six60 on Saturday. Kids Take Over closes at HOTA today (its final day), and Anastasia The Musical continues its enchanting Brisbane season through to 18 October. Groundwater Country Music Festival fills free Broadbeach stages with 60+ artists on 16–18 October, and the Boost Mobile Gold Coast 500 transforms Surfers Paradise into a world-class street circuit 23–25 October.
topPicksTitle: Top Things To Do This Week (26 Sep – 3 Oct)

topPicks.name: Kids Take Over Festival
topPicks.desc: Last chance today — HOTA's space-themed school-holiday spectacular wraps up this afternoon. Erth's Dinosaurs, Hot Potato Band, the Galactic Space Wall and free daily activities for the whole family.

topPicks.name: BLEACH Festival Opens
topPicks.desc: The Gold Coast's signature arts festival launches Thursday — eleven days of free and ticketed shows, live music, installations and theatre. Free family programming daily at HOTA from day one.

topPicks.name: Lady Blackbird & Electric Fields — Free
topPicks.desc: BLEACH's unmissable free opening concert: internationally acclaimed US soul vocalist Lady Blackbird headlines alongside Electric Fields. All ages, free tickets required — book before they go.

topPicks.name: Six60 at BLEACH
topPicks.desc: New Zealand's highest-selling live band headline HOTA's Outdoor Stage on Saturday night, joined by Sub-Tribe. Roots, soul and dubstep under the stars — $89 tickets, all ages, standing.

events.name: Lady Blackbird & Electric Fields
events.desc: BLEACH Festival opens with a free double bill on HOTA's Outdoor Stage — internationally acclaimed jazz-soul singer Lady Blackbird headlines alongside Electric Fields, whose Zaachariaha Fielding sings in the traditional language of the Anangu People. Free tickets required.
events.location: HOTA Outdoor Stage, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive

events.name: BLEACH Festival 2026
events.desc: The Gold Coast's signature arts festival returns — eleven days of live music, theatre and large-scale spectacle at HOTA and across the city, headlined by Six60. The Coast at its most alive.

events.name: Six60 at BLEACH Festival
events.desc: New Zealand's highest-selling live band bring their electrifying blend of roots, soul and dubstep to HOTA's Outdoor Stage, with Sub-Tribe in support. An all-ages, all-standing show from 6 pm — $89 tickets.
events.location: HOTA Outdoor Stage, Surfers Paradise · 10 min drive

events.name: 100 Keyboards
events.desc: Japanese sound artist ASUNA fills HOTA Gallery 3 with over 100 toy keyboards — a meditative, shimmering wall of sound exploring acoustic interference, resonance and imperfect tuning. 1 hr 20 min, ages 16+.

events.name: This Moment — Dining at Palette
events.desc: HOTA's This Moment exhibition spills into Palette restaurant — art-inspired dining where the menu answers the gallery. A refined long lunch, ten minutes from the villa.

events.name: Gold Coast Open House
events.desc: A free weekend of architectural access — private homes, landmark infrastructure and award-winning public buildings open their doors. Highlights include Palm Beach Aquatic Centre, Hinze Dam tours and the Gold Coast Desalination Plant. Self-guided, city-wide.

events.name: Anastasia The Musical
events.desc: The sweeping Broadway musical journeys from the twilight of the Russian Empire to 1920s Paris — lavish, romantic and made for a special night out.

events.name: Groundwater Country Music Festival
events.desc: Free three-day country music celebration across Broadbeach — Kasey Chambers, Kaylee Bell, The Wolfe Brothers and 60+ acts on outdoor stages. No tickets, no fuss, just great music in the sun.

events.name: Boost Mobile Gold Coast 500
events.desc: Surfers Paradise transforms into a world-class street circuit for Round 12 of the Repco Supercars Championship — 10 drivers in title contention, beachside grandstands and non-stop entertainment. Kids 12 and under free with a paying adult.
events.location: Surfers Paradise Street Circuit · 15 min drive
